best_for: Creative kids who want to make their own games
Young learners curious about how computers work
target_audience.who_should_take_foundation_first: Absolute beginners can start here, no foundation needed.

prerequisites.required: Basic ability to read, write, and use a mouse/keyboard.
prerequisites.recommended: A curious mind and love for puzzles.

system_requirements.hardware: A computer or laptop with internet access (Windows, Mac, or Chromebook).
system_requirements.software_accounts: Modern web browser, free accounts on Scratch and Tinkercad.

overview.positioning: A comprehensive introductory journey into the world of technology for kids.
overview.short_description: Learn to code, design, and create with Future Tech Kids Mastery! Explore block coding, build your first websites, create 3D models, and discover the magic of AI.

key_facts.capstone: Build a Complete Interactive Game or Website Showcase
key_facts.ai_integration: High - Uses AI as a learning companion

what_you_will_be_able_to_do: Create interactive stories and games in Scratch
Draw amazing digital art using Python Turtle
Build simple, colorful web pages with HTML and CSS
Design awesome 3D models for printing or virtual worlds
Use AI tools safely to brainstorm and create

why_now.industry_shift: Digital literacy is becoming as fundamental as reading and writing.
why_now.ai_impact: AI is changing how we create; early exposure demystifies technology.
why_now.business_demand: Future careers will require strong problem-solving and technical skills.
why_now.career_opportunity: Early exposure builds confidence for advanced STEM learning.

learning_outcomes: CODE: Develop interactive games and animations using visual blocks.
DRAW: Program digital shapes and patterns using Python.
BUILD: Construct simple web pages with text, images, and colors.
DESIGN: Create 3D objects and characters in virtual space.
EXPLORE: Interact safely with AI to generate ideas and art.

stages.focus: Transitioning to typing code with Python Turtle.
Building pages with HTML and CSS.
Designing in 3D and using AI tools creatively.

emerging_tools.purpose: Brainstorming and learning AI concepts safely

industry_workflow.overview: The standard process of turning a fun idea into a working digital project.

stages.name: Imagine
stages.desc: Brainstorming ideas and sketching out what to build.

stages.name: Plan
stages.desc: Breaking down the idea into smaller, manageable steps.

stages.name: Create
stages.desc: Coding, designing, or building the project.

stages.name: Test & Share
stages.desc: Finding bugs, fixing them, and showing the project to friends and family.

ai_integration.ai_can_assist_with: Explaining bugs in simple terms, generating story ideas for games.
ai_integration.ai_cannot_replace: The student's creativity and logical problem-solving.
ai_integration.human_expertise_required: Adult supervision is required for safe AI use.
ai_integration.validation_protocol: Students review AI suggestions to see if they make sense.
ai_integration.responsible_use: Learning not to copy-paste, but to use AI for inspiration.

best_practices: Always plan your game on paper before coding.
Test your code often so bugs don't pile up.
Ask for help when you get stuck, but try to find the answer first.

common_mistakes.mistake: Writing too much code without testing.
common_mistakes.why_it_happens: Excitement to see the final result.
common_mistakes.professional_approach: Code a little, test a little. It makes finding errors much easier.
Always write the opening and closing tags together before putting content inside.

career_paths.employer_expectations: Curiosity, willingness to learn, and basic problem-solving.
career_paths.what_student_demonstrates: Ability to complete digital projects from idea to final product.

freelance_applications.portfolio_requirements: A fun online gallery of Scratch games and 3D designs to share with family.

what_you_will_build: A digital spirograph using Python Turtle
A personal hobby website in HTML
final_deliverables: A final presentation video explaining their favorite creation

assessment.criteria: Creativity, logic application, code functionality, and presentation skills.

certification.title: Future Tech Master Certificate
certification.criteria: Complete all core projects and present the final showcase.

not_covered: Advanced software engineering, server management, complex mathematics.

next_learning_path.recommended_next: Young Coders Program or Python for Kids

faq.question: Does my child need prior coding experience?
faq.answer: Not at all! This course starts from the absolute basics using fun, visual blocks.

faq.question: Is the AI tool safe for my child to use?
faq.answer: Yes, we use supervised, kid-friendly AI interfaces and teach safe, responsible interaction.

faq.question: What kind of computer is needed?
faq.answer: Any standard laptop or computer (Windows, Mac, or Chromebook) with a modern web browser and internet connection will work perfectly.

modules.module_purpose: Introduce programming logic through intuitive, drag-and-drop blocks.
what_you_will_learn: How to make characters move and speak
Creating a scoring system with variables

lessons.what_is_taught: Basic sequencing and event triggers (Green Flag).
lessons.why_it_matters: It’s the foundation of making things happen on a computer.
lessons.what_learner_does: Makes a cat walk across the screen and meow.

lessons.why_it_matters: Saves time by not having to snap the same blocks over and over.
lessons.what_learner_does: Creates a dance party animation with repeating moves.

lessons.why_it_matters: Allows games to react to player inputs or collisions.
lessons.what_learner_does: Builds a simple game where a character avoids falling objects.

lessons.why_it_matters: Essential for tracking game progress and scores.
lessons.what_learner_does: Adds a points system and a timer to the mini-game.

modules.hands_on_practice: Build a custom interactive story or game from scratch.
modules.assignment: Submit the link to a completed Scratch game with at least one variable and one loop.
modules.business_application: Understanding game mechanics and user interaction.
modules.expected_outcome: Comfortable with basic programming logic using visual blocks.

modules.module_purpose: Transition from visual blocks to typing real code by drawing shapes.

lessons.why_it_matters: Introduces text-based syntax in a highly visual way.
lessons.what_learner_does: Writes code to make the turtle draw a square.
lessons.expected_outcome: A basic Python script that draws a shape.

lessons.why_it_matters: Shows how code controls visual styling.
lessons.what_learner_does: Draws a colorful, thick-lined star.

lessons.why_it_matters: Demonstrates the power of iteration in text coding.
lessons.what_learner_does: Uses a loop to draw a complex spiral pattern.
lessons.expected_outcome: A geometric spiral generated by code.

lessons.why_it_matters: Introduces unpredictability and basic game mechanics in Python.
lessons.what_learner_does: Codes a race between different colored turtles.

modules.hands_on_practice: Create a unique piece of digital art using loops and colors.
modules.assignment: Submit a Python script that draws a recognizable object (like a house or car).
modules.expected_outcome: Ability to write simple Python scripts independently.

modules.module_purpose: Learn the basics of how web pages are built using HTML and CSS.
what_you_will_learn: Structuring a page with HTML tags
Styling with CSS colors and fonts

lessons.why_it_matters: Every website in the world uses these fundamental building blocks.
lessons.what_learner_does: Writes an HTML page about their favorite hobby.

lessons.why_it_matters: Makes the web interactive and visually interesting.
lessons.what_learner_does: Adds photos and links to other sites on their hobby page.

lessons.why_it_matters: Turns a boring document into a beautiful design.
lessons.what_learner_does: Styles their hobby page with their favorite colors and fonts.

lessons.why_it_matters: Helps organize content neatly on the screen.
lessons.what_learner_does: Creates a mini-portfolio to showcase their Scratch and Turtle projects.
lessons.expected_outcome: A complete, personal web page layout.

modules.hands_on_practice: Build a multi-section web page dedicated to a favorite topic.
modules.assignment: Submit the HTML/CSS code for a fully styled personal web page.
modules.expected_outcome: Ability to create and style simple web pages.

modules.module_purpose: Explore spatial design and the creative potential of AI tools.
what_you_will_learn: Combining shapes to make complex models
Using AI for brainstorming ideas safely

lessons.what_is_taught: Moving, rotating, and scaling shapes in Tinkercad.
lessons.why_it_matters: Develops spatial reasoning for engineering and design.
lessons.what_learner_does: Builds a simple 3D house.

lessons.why_it_matters: Essential techniques for creating custom, printable objects.
lessons.what_learner_does: Designs a custom name tag or keychain.
lessons.expected_outcome: A complete 3D model ready for printing.

lessons.what_is_taught: How to ask good questions (prompts) to an AI.
lessons.why_it_matters: Prompt engineering is a key skill for the future.
lessons.what_learner_does: Uses a kid-safe AI to generate ideas for a new game.

lessons.what_is_taught: Collaborating with AI to write a narrative.
lessons.why_it_matters: Shows how technology can boost, not replace, human creativity.
lessons.what_learner_does: Writes an interactive story where AI helps create the plot twists.

modules.hands_on_practice: Design a 3D character and use AI to write its backstory.
modules.assignment: Submit a screenshot of the 3D model and the AI-assisted story.
modules.expected_outcome: Basic competence in 3D modeling and safe AI prompting.

modules.module_purpose: Combine all learned skills to build one large, impressive final project.

lessons.why_it_matters: Big projects need a solid plan to succeed.
lessons.what_learner_does: Sketches out their final project (game, website, or 3D world).

lessons.why_it_matters: Develops resilience and self-reliance.
lessons.what_learner_does: Spends the session actively building their project.
lessons.expected_outcome: A working prototype of the project.

lessons.why_it_matters: Feedback improves the final product significantly.
lessons.what_learner_does: Has a classmate or parent test the project, then fixes bugs.

lessons.why_it_matters: Being able to explain your work is as important as building it.
lessons.what_learner_does: Records a short video or gives a live demo of their creation.
lessons.expected_outcome: A final presentation celebrating their achievements.

modules.assignment: Submit the final project files and presentation video.
modules.expected_outcome: A comprehensive portfolio piece demonstrating all course skills.
